notes: No state-wide 2026-27 MD/MS fee order for government colleges was found (KEA had not posted its 2026-27 fee structure/government fee order by 25-10-2026; the 22-10-2026 KEA notification only extends registration to 25-10-2026; the KEA PG e-brochure says the fee structure is 'issued by the Government' separately and prints no figures). 'inr' = the figure the notice prints in the column named in seat_as_printed; extra keys (other_fees, first_year_total_inr, total_course_inr/usd, tuition_inr, as_printed, waiver) keep the printed components.
